mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVATT20551.retrieveAttContractOrg */ ATT.ORGANIZATION_ID AS CODE ,ORG_M.ORG_NAME_LOCAL AS NAME FROM TB_ATT_CONTRACT_N ATT LEFT OUTER JOIN ORG_MASTER ORG_M ON (ATT.ORGANIZATION_ID = ORG_M.ORGANIZATION_ID) WHERE ATT.TIME_ATTEND_CONTACT_USER_ID=#{employeeNo} AND att.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND SYSDATE BETWEEN nvl(att.effective_start_date, to_date('0001-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND NVL(att.effective_end_date, to_date('9999-12-31', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND SYSDATE BETWEEN nvl(ORG_M.org_start_date, to_date('0001-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND NVL(ORG_M.org_end_date, to_date('9999-12-31', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) ORDER BY ORG_M.ORG_NAME_LOCAL

SELECT /* LGVATT20551.retrieveAttContractOrgLineWorkerList */ ATT.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ORGANIZATION_ID ,M.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER AS CODE ,M.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER AS NAME FROM TB_ATT_CONTRACT_N ATT LEFT OUTER JOIN EMP_MASTER M ON (ATT.ORGANIZATION_ID = M.ORGANIZATION_ID) WHERE ATT.TIME_ATTEND_CONTACT_USER_ID=#{employeeNo} AND att.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND SYSDATE BETWEEN nvl(att.effective_start_date, to_date('0001-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND NVL(att.effective_end_date, to_date('9999-12-31', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND M.Status = 'Active Assignment' AND M.flsa_yn = 'N' AND M.fse_yn = 'N'
SELECT /* LGVATT20551."retrieveEmployeeName" */ M.FULL_NAME_LOCAL AS EMPLOYEE_NAME ,M.ATTRIBUTE10 AS SHIFT_TYPE_CODE FROM EMP_MASTER M WHERE M.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER=#{employeeNo}

SELECT EM.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ORGANIZATION_ID ,EM.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER CODE ,EM.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER NAME ,lgvatt_common_pkg.get_unit_requestor( #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} ,#{orgId} ) AS org_get_arm_info FROM EMP_MASTER EM WHERE EM.ORGANIZATION_ID = #{orgId} AND EM.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND EM.Status = 'Active Assignment' AND EM.flsa_yn = 'N' AND EM.fse_yn = 'N' ORDER BY EM.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER

employee_name ,sv.grade_title_name AS title_name ,sv.department_code AS department_code /* 결재자 조직코드 */ ,sv.organization_name AS department_name ,sv.position_name AS position_name ,'APPROVAL' AS approval_action_code ,md.application_user_id AS mandator_user_id /* 위임자 application_user_id */ ,md.user_name AS mandator_employee_no /* 위임자 사번 */ ,md.local_language_full_name AS mendator_employee_name ,md.position_name AS mendator_title_name ,md.department_code AS mendator_department_code FROM emp_master em ,lgcom_user_m sv ,lgcom_user_m md WHERE em.employee_number = #{ARM_PARAM.employeeNo} AND em.attribute1 IS NOT NULL AND em.attribute1 = sv.user_name AND em.attribute4 = md.user_name(+) UNION ALL SELECT sv.application_user_id AS employee_id /* 결재자 application_user_id */ ,sv.user_name AS ,sv.position_name AS position_name ,'APPROVAL' AS approval_action_code ,md.application_user_id AS mandator_user_id /* 위임자 application_user_id */ ,md.user_name AS mandator_employee_no /* 위임자 사번 */ ,md.local_language_full_name AS mendator_employee_name ,md.position_name AS mendator_title_name ,md.department_code AS mendator_department_code FROM emp_master em ,lgcom_user_m sv ,lgcom_user_m md WHERE em.employee_number = #{ARM_PARAM.employeeNo} AND em.attribute2 IS NOT NULL AND em.attribute2 = sv.user_name AND em.attribute5 = md.user_name(+) UNION ALL SELECT sv.application_user_id AS department_code /* 결재자 조직코드 */ ,sv.organization_name AS department_name ,sv.position_name AS position_name ,'APPROVAL' AS approval_action_code ,md.application_user_id AS mandator_user_id /* 위임자 application_user_id */ ,md.user_name AS mandator_employee_no /* 위임자 사번 */ ,md.local_language_full_name AS mendator_employee_name ,md.position_name AS mendator_title_name ,md.department_code AS title_name ,sv.department_code AS department_code /* 결재자 조직코드 */ ,sv.organization_name AS department_name ,sv.position_name AS position_name ,'APPROVAL' AS approval_action_code ,md.application_user_id AS mandator_user_id /* 위임자 application_user_id */ ,md.user_name AS mandator_employee_no /* 위임자 사번 */ ,md.local_language_full_name AS mendator_employee_name ,md.position_name AS mendator_title_name ,md.department_code AS mendator_department_code FROM emp_master em ,lgcom_user_m sv ,lgcom_user_m md WHERE em.employee_number = lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGVHR_ATT_COMMON_CODE', 'HR_APPROVAL_LINE', 'A2') AND em.employee_number = sv.user_name AND em.attribute2 != sv.user_name AND em.employee_number = md.user_name(+) AND em.employee_number != #{createBy} AND NOT EXISTS (select 1 from emp_master e where e.employee_number = #{ARM_PARAM.employeeNo} and (e.attribute2 = em.employee_number or e.attribute5 = em.employee_number or e.attribute1 = em.employee_number or e.attribute4 = ,sv.grade_title_name AS title_name ,sv.department_code AS department_code /* 결재자 조직코드 */ ,sv.organization_name AS department_name ,sv.position_name AS position_name ,'APPROVAL' AS approval_action_code ,md.application_user_id AS mandator_user_id /* 위임자 application_user_id */ ,md.user_name AS mandator_employee_no /* 위임자 사번 */ ,md.local_language_full_name AS mendator_employee_name ,md.position_name AS mendator_title_name ,md.department_code AS mendator_department_code FROM emp_master em ,lgcom_organization_m om ,lgcom_user_m sv ,lgcom_user_m md WHERE em.employee_number = om.organization_manager_emp_no AND om.organization_code = NVL((select NVL(lm.division_code, '84001') from lgcom_organization_m lm where lm.organization_code = #{ARM_PARAM.organizationId}),'84001') AND em.employee_number = sv.user_name AND em.employee_number = md.user_name(+)

SELECT /* LGVATT20551.retrieveRequestDocBaseInfo */ cc.code_data1_value AS arm_no , cc.parent_common_code AS request_code /* LGCOM 결재의 문서유형코드LGCOM_APPROVAL_REQUEST_CODE와 매핑 */ FROM lgcom_common_code_c cc WHERE cc.code_type_code = 'LGVCOM_APPROVAL_REQUEST_CODE' AND cc.common_code = 'ATT0007' /* 사무직 수정요청서 결재요청 */

SELECT /* LGVATT20551.retrieveRequestHeaderInfo */ EM.FULL_NAME_LOCAL AS requestor_info ,(SELECT common_code_name FROM LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_MULTI_LANG_C WHERE code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_REQ_STATUS_CODE' AND language_code = NVL('en','en') AND common_code = ATT_SO.PROGRESS_STATUS_CODE) AS status_name ,TO_CHAR(ATT_SO.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS request_date , ATT_SO.PROGRESS_STATUS_CODE as startus_code
FROM TB_ATT_SWAP_HOLIDAY_REQUEST_N ATT_SO LEFT OUTER JOIN EMP_MASTER EM ON (ATT_SO.EMPLOYEE_NO = EM.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER) LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_att_result_n tar ON (tar.employee_no = ATT_SO.EMPLOYEE_NO AND TAR.time_and_attendance_date = ATT_SO.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_DATE) WHERE 1=1 AND ATT_SO.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_DATE = TO_DATE(#{timeAndAttendanceDate}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AND ATT_SO.EMPLOYEE_NO = #{employeeNo} AND ATT_SO.SUBSIDIARY_CODE = #{subsidiaryCode} AND ATT_SO.LAST_UPDATE_USER_ID = #{sessionUserId}

SELECT /* LGVATT20551.checkWorkingTime */ TO_NUMBER(lgvatt_common_pkg.get_work_days_by_swap(#{subsidiaryCode}, TO_DATE(#{weeklyHoliday}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), TO_DATE(#{workingDay}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'),#{employeeNo}, 'WORKING_TIME')) AS count ,lgvatt_common_pkg.get_work_days_by_swap(#{subsidiaryCode}, TO_DATE(#{weeklyHoliday}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), TO_DATE(#{workingDay}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'),#{employeeNo}, 'START_DATE') AS start_date ,lgvatt_common_pkg.get_work_days_by_swap(#{subsidiaryCode}, TO_DATE(#{weeklyHoliday}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), TO_DATE(#{workingDay}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'),#{employeeNo}, 'END_DATE') AS end_date ,(select t.shift_type_code from tb_att_result_n t where t.subsidiary_code = #{subsidiaryCode} and t.time_and_attendance_date = TO_DATE(#{weeklyHoliday}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') and t.employee_no = #{employeeNo}) as weekly_holiday_shift_type_code ,(select t.shift_type_code from tb_att_result_n t where t.subsidiary_code = #{subsidiaryCode} and t.time_and_attendance_date = TO_DATE(#{workingDay}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') and t.employee_no = #{employeeNo}) as working_day_shift_type_code FROM dual

SELECT /* LGVATT20551.retrieveSwapdate */ lgvatt_common_pkg.get_work_days_by_swap(#{subsidiaryCode}, TO_DATE(#{weeklyHoliday}, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_DATE(#{weeklyHoliday}, 'YYYYMMDD'),#{employeeNo}, #{type}) AS swap_date FROM dual
